tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List every GStars documentation page with its path, title, description and last-updated date. Use it to see what documentation exists.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Find GStars documentation pages matching a question or keywords (case-insensitive), ranked by relevance with a text snippet. Use it before get_doc.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return one GStars documentation page as Markdown, by the path that list_docs or search_docs returned (for example /methodology).
